description: Telecomunicaciones CyL WMS is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idecyl.jcyl.es. Service of visualization of maps of telecommunications services and the Network of Spaces CyL Digital. Web map service compliant with the Web Map Service:OGC-WMS standard. Provides access for visualization and consultation of thematic geographic information of telecommunications networks, infrastructures, facilities and related services, in the Community of Castilla y León. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "CyL WMS Telecommunications" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
